experiments.hypothesis: Explicit complete-permitted-corpus mode can abstain without generative inference when evidence is exactly empty.
experiments.risk: Does not apply to live retrieval, unsupported malformed input, or permission to use outside knowledge.
experiments.acceptance: No verdict/coverage changes on development and validation; zero fallback calls for empty corpus; no shortcut for partial corpus or bypass. Archived cloud replay is counterfactual call/cost accounting, never live Gemini latency.

experiments.hypothesis: Bounded exact evaluator reuse reduces warm local CPU overhead with identical verdicts.
experiments.risk: Stale or cross-scope reuse; mutable cached objects; model/calibration changes.
experiments.acceptance: At least 20% P95 local evaluation reduction on repeated validation, zero verdict drift; TTL, revision, polarity, temporal, evidence and permission isolation tests pass. No Gemini answers cached, no semantic-similarity reuse; no central-cache claim.

experiments.hypothesis: Fixed lightweight lexical/numeric-context features improve a logistic evidence head beyond five baseline features. No feature independently establishes truth.
experiments.training: Existing 2000 development questions only; C=1, seed1729, max_iter500; one prespecified candidate; no hyperparameter sweep.
experiments.calibration: Same existing disjoint fit/risk calibration components, all three mappings compared by validation Brier. Never open locked evaluation or fresh48 cohort.
experiments.gate: Retain candidate only if calibrated validation decision accuracy and definitive coverage do not decrease and empirical selective risk does not increase; otherwise reject. No production qualification or live Gemini advantage claim.

experiments.hypothesis: Two available CPU cores reduce FP32 encoder latency versus one inference thread.
experiments.gate: At least 20% local P95 improvement with no observed decision drift on 120 fixed balanced validation questions x3 paired randomized repeats. Keep runtime experimental until independent recalibration; reject if no material gain.
experiments.resources: Two CPU cores already available; no new compute provisioning or charges.

experiments.hypothesis: A pinned Apache-2.0 DeBERTa-v3-small NLI encoder improves evidence understanding over MiniLM; evaluate quantized ONNX without Torch/GPU.
experiments.data: Existing development/validation/calibration only; never score fresh48 or locked evaluation.
experiments.screen: 120 fixed balanced validation questions; proceed only if raw classification accuracy is at least MiniLM FP32.
experiments.gate: One fixed C=1 logistic head if screen passes; separate existing calibration groups; retain research only if calibrated validation accuracy and coverage do not decrease and selective risk does not increase. No public/production promotion.
experiments.resource_stop: 45-minute total local bound, source licensing failure, download limit, or no material improvement. Current live paid campaign remains frozen on MiniLM.

experiments.hypothesis: Fail closed on definitive matched-evidence Gemini responses whose cited URL/quote cannot be matched to the permitted evidence. This is a provenance-format guard, not entailment proof.
experiments.rule: At least one citation, every URL and exact nonempty quote belongs to the supplied corpus; allow URL field capitalization. Apply equally to standalone and routed responses. Invalid outputs become MAYBE with a distinct failure reason, not INVALID input.
experiments.evaluation: Unit/security regressions plus archived label-independent citation audit. Current live job stays frozen on its submitted implementation; any replay of this new guard is explicitly counterfactual, not a new live result.
experiments.scope: No guard on Google Search grounded mode in this change; matched evidence only.

measurement: Fixed existing validation corpus; no reopening or tuning on locked evaluation. Three randomized paired repetitions. Cold-cache and warm-cache conditions separate; warm priming included in amortized aggregate and separately reported.
stopping: 30 minute local bound, critical independent evaluation unavailable, or three experiments without material Pareto improvement. Larger live Gemini follow-up requires separate concrete spending authorization after preparation.
production_policy: Preserved. New features opt-in in research router, .80 floor unchanged. No public release without full gates.
campaign05_authorization: User explicitly authorized up to $8 for the prepared 48-question comparison; reauthentication remains pending. Campaign04 itself made no paid calls.
extension_reason: Use the waiting time of the already frozen live cloud comparison for one separately isolated CPU-only pretrained-model challenger; no new paid calls or cloud policy changes.
